record.paper_title: QCD, from its inception to its stubbornly unsolved problems
record.original_question: What is the correct internal structure of the observed tetraquark and pentaquark resonances: compact bag-like states containing all the quarks together, molecule-like bound states of two substructures, or the colored-molecule picture proposed for some states containing two heavy quarks?

evidence.quote: There have been vivid discussions on whether the observed tetra- and pentaquark resonances are atom-like –that is, “bags” containing all the quarks– or molecule-like –that is, bound states of two “sub-bags”.
This is an interesting twist in the atom vs molecule debate: a third possibility.

artifact.status_search_result: Recent reviews (PDG 2024/2025 pentaquark review, CERN Courier, and several 2023–2025 surveys) state that the internal structure of observed tetraquarks and pentaquarks remains unresolved: compact and molecular pictures each explain part of the data but neither explains all observations, and some states may be superpositions. The colored-molecule picture is still actively discussed for doubly-heavy exotics. Thus the question is open.

status_evidence.title: PDG 2024 Pentaquarks Review
status_evidence.snippet: Compact and molecular pictures each explain part of the data, but neither explains all; certain states may be superpositions.
status_evidence.claim: The internal structure of pentaquark/tetraquark states is unresolved as of 2024/25.

status_evidence.title: Inside pentaquarks and tetraquarks – CERN Courier
status_evidence.snippet: There still remains a question whether these particles are indeed compact particles or hadronic molecules.
status_evidence.claim: Compact vs molecular nature of exotics remains debated.

status_evidence.title: Tetraquarks and Pentaquarks from Quark Model Perspective (MDPI 2023)
status_evidence.snippet: Both compact and molecular structures appear in nature; identification requires further study.
status_evidence.claim: Structure of observed exotics is not uniquely determined.
